entities.name: The Great Flood
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The catastrophic deluge described in Genesis 6–9, sent by God in judgment upon human wickedness. Noah, his family, and representatives of all animals survived in the Ark. The post-Flood covenant (signified by the rainbow) marks a new beginning for humanity.
